fixture_purpose: Deterministic end-to-end regression coverage for broker import, projection, and reconciliation paths.
selected_regression_scenarios: Treasury purchases, accrued interest, coupon, and redemption
IBKR deposits, cross-currency trade, dividend, interest, and withholding tax
XTB investment-plan rebooking and tracked-account transfer
XTB retirement-account FX, income, and tax
anonymization_policy: Identity-bearing fields and private source metadata are anonymized or removed. The corpus contains no credentials or private-source fingerprints.
semantic_preservation_policy: Dates, amounts, currencies, symbols, quantities, prices, cash-operation types, position IDs, transfer relationships, and business semantics required for deterministic regression coverage are preserved.
